findings.claim: The MessagePackSecurity copy constructor no longer preserves HashCollisionResistant, so cloning an existing security instance silently changes its behavior. This is unrelated to generated-code coverage and can weaken collision protection for users that copy UntrustedData or another configured instance.

receipt_plan.detail: Add or run a unit test constructing MessagePackSecurity.UntrustedData, copying it with new MessagePackSecurity(original), and asserting copy.HashCollisionResistant == original.HashCollisionResistant; repeat with a security instance whose HashCollisionResistant value is explicitly configured. The head copy will retain its default instead.
